name: @qf-jarvis/anisha-agent
description: QF Jarvis Anisha vendor-journey behaviour (QFJ-S3-D-A, ADR-0070). The vendor half of the agent layer, and nothing else: a closed vendor-journey intent vocabulary, a content-minimised context snapshot carrying opaque references and money-adjacent BANDS (never balances), and one deterministic turn decision. Anisha is fixed to ANISHA/VENDOR and refuses client work before any model is reached. She notices and explains; she never verifies, activates, ranks, assigns, mutates a profile, changes a package, touches money, or scores lead quality -- every one of those is QuickFurno Core's. It builds no runtime, no router, no state machine, no port and no proposal helper -- those are owned by ADR-0054/0055/0057/0059/0066/0068 and are reused, never replaced. No prompt text (opaque promptRef only), no model call, no memory, no transport, no persistence, no external action. Depends on @qf-jarvis/agent-runtime and zod.
